prompt: Build a CLI script agg.py --group COL --sum VAL reading CSV from stdin and printing sorted `group,total` lines rounded to 2 decimals.
hidden_test_content:
import subprocess
csv_in = 'team,cost\neng,1.5\nops,2.0\neng,2.25\n'
p = subprocess.run(['python3', 'agg.py', '--group', 'team', '--sum', 'cost'], input=csv_in, text=True, capture_output=True)
assert p.returncode == 0
assert p.stdout.strip().splitlines() == ['eng,3.75', 'ops,2.00']
